model.description: Generative diffusion enhancement model. Starlight Precise 2.6 adds realism to AI-generated video; Starlight HQ maximizes quality on high-resolution sources; Starlight Mini restores archival footage; Starlight Sharp is fast restoration with sharper detail; Starlight Fast 2 is the fastest, cheapest diffusion upscaler.
model.title: Model

target_fps.description: Target FPS for the output. Frame interpolation is enabled only when this differs from the source FPS.
target_fps.title: Target Fps

H264_output.description: Whether to use H264 codec for output video. Default is H265.
H264_output.title: H264 Output

softness.description: How much softening the model applies to the output, from 1 (sharpest) to 5 (softest). Starlight Precise 2.6 only; leave unset for Topaz's default.
softness.title: Softness

video_url.description: URL of the video to upscale
video_url.title: Video Url

upscale_factor.description: Factor to upscale the video by (e.g. 2.0 doubles width and height)
upscale_factor.title: Upscale Factor

file_size.description: The size of the file in bytes.
file_size.title: File Size

file_name.description: The name of the file. It will be auto-generated if not provided.
file_name.title: File Name

content_type.description: The mime type of the file.
content_type.title: Content Type

url.description: The URL where the file can be downloaded from.
url.title: Url
